All user-supplied content is escaped to prevent XSS. Tags are wrapped in elements and each tag value is escaped as well. Parameters: author_name (str): Identifier of the post's creator. title (str): Heading of the user's post. body_content (str): Primary content of the user's post. tag_list (list[str]): Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns: str: XSS-protected HTML string for the forum post. """ # Escape all user inputs safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_content, quote=False) # Preserve newlines # Build tags string safe_tags = ''.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_list ) # Format the template with escaped values rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags ) return rendered
